message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (Standard Edition)** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by collecting cards left in opponents’ hands at the end of each round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck (108 cards: 0‑9, Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, Wild Draw Four).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile.
• **Wild** cards can be played on any card and let you choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** can only be played if you have no other playable card; you choose the next color. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have only one card left, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points based on the cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. The first player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | | **Variations** | • **Stacking** – Some house rules allow stacking Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards.
• **Speed** – Play without drawing; the first to discard all cards wins.
• **Custom Rules** – Many groups add house rules (e.g., “Draw 4” can be played on any card). | **Quick Tips** 1. Keep track of the colors that have been played to anticipate opponents’ options. 2. Use Wild cards strategically to change the color when you’re stuck. 3. Remember to call “UNO” loudly enough to avoid penalties. Enjoy your game!
